hero.primaryCta: Tell me what you need to build
hero.proof: From focused web projects to complex products · Built around business needs

problem.title: The right digital solution starts with your business goal.
problem.body: Some businesses need a clear place online. Others need software that fits the way they work. The right starting point depends on the goal, the people involved, and the problem to solve.
items: Your business needs a clear online presence.
Customers need an easier way to understand what you offer.
A daily task takes too much manual effort.
Information is spread across disconnected tools.
A business process needs a purpose-built system.
A product idea needs to become a digital experience.
problem.closing: The solution can be a website, custom software, or a digital product. First, define what needs to work better.

capabilities.title: Digital work, shaped around your needs
capabilities.intro: I work across web projects and software products. We start with what the business needs, then choose a scope that fits the goal.

items.title: Websites & digital presence
items.description: I build landing pages, institutional and corporate websites, and commercial websites tailored to your business goals.

items.title: Custom business software
items.description: I create back offices and internal systems, add process automation, and connect tools through integrations.

items.title: Digital products
items.description: I design and build web apps, mobile apps, SaaS products, and MVPs around a clear product goal.

capabilities.iaNote: I use AI when it truly improves a process: information extraction, classification, assistance, analysis, or reducing costly tasks. If traditional automation is simpler, more reliable, and more affordable, I prefer that solution.

steps.title: Understand
steps.description: First I learn how the operation works today, who is involved, what information they use, and where friction appears.

steps.title: Define
steps.description: We prioritize the right problem and decide whether to automate, integrate existing tools, or build something new.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: I develop the solution in stages, validating important decisions before adding complexity.

steps.title: Put into production
steps.description: The solution has to work outside a demo: real data, real users, permissions, errors, and maintenance.

items.name: Marfen
items.title: A commerce management and point-of-sale system for businesses.

items.name: Insurance operations ecosystem
items.title: Evolving a digital ecosystem connected to real insurance operations.
items.description: I contribute to digital products and systems that support insurance operations, working across mobile applications, backend services, internal tools, integrations, and automations.

items.name: Helmcode Cloud Products

marfenCase.title: Commerce management and point of sale for businesses
body: Marfen is a commerce management and point-of-sale system for businesses.
I designed and built the product to bring together sales, inventory, cash management, purchases, suppliers, store credit, and profitability in one system.

professionalCase.title: From a process that took days to one completed in hours
professionalCase.problem: An operational process depended on different information sources, validations, and manual steps that required coordination among several parties.
professionalCase.decision: The process was mapped end to end to identify bottlenecks, clarify handoffs, and remove steps that did not add control or value.
professionalCase.solution: Automations, data transformations, and validations were added to reduce manual work and make each step easier to trace.
professionalCase.result: A process that took several days was completed in a matter of hours.
professionalCase.cta: Do you have a similar process?

experienceSummary.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm Marco Galván, a software developer and product builder. I design and build websites, business systems, and digital products.
I focus on understanding the business goal first, then deciding what kind of digital solution and scope make sense.
I work directly with the people who know the business, from defining the need through building and delivery.

fit.title: I can help bring this to life if…
items: Your business needs a focused landing page or commercial website.
You need a digital presence that clearly explains what you offer.
A business process needs a better-fit system.
Your team relies on repeated manual tasks.
You need to connect tools or organize information.
You have a software product to shape or build.
You know the goal, even if the right solution is not clear yet.
fit.note: If you are only looking for programming hours at the lowest possible cost, I am probably not the best fit.
